description: Not insomnia in the ordinary sense. The person falls asleep and surfaces every forty minutes to check whether the sound was outside or inside the dream. Deep sleep is what stops, and deep sleep is where memory is filed.
energy_note: Tired in a way that sleeping does not fix.

description: Everyone in a bombarded city becomes an amateur acoustician: outgoing or incoming, interceptor or impact, near or far. The skill is genuinely useful and it is also a permanent background process that never switches off.
energy_note: A part of the mind permanently assigned to listening.

aspect: Deciding about the basement, every time
description: Going down costs stairs, cold, other people and twenty minutes. Not going down costs nothing until the one time it does. It is a decision with no right answer and it is made several times a night.
energy_note: A coin flip you have to keep calling.

description: Waves of strikes at all hours across a city of nearly ten million. The government texted residents to leave 'if possible while remaining calm'. Streets emptied, businesses shut, water and electricity facilities were damaged and people were asked to conserve.
energy_note: A whole city put on the same broken sleep schedule.
notes: Also: schools and universities closed by Supreme National Security Council directive.

aspect: The startle response outlives the war
description: Years later a door, a firework, a motorbike backfiring produces a full adrenal response in under 200 milliseconds - before any thought is possible. The person apologises for it, which does not stop it.
energy_note: Embarrassed by your own reflexes, in a safe country.
notes: Common report in chemical- and conventional-warfare survivor cohorts alike.

description: The first night they all went down. The second, most of them. By the fourth his mother refuses to move because the stairs hurt her knees more than the noise frightens her, and he sits on the landing between her and the door, which solves nothing and is the only thing he can do.
energy_note: Guarding a staircase against a missile.

aspect: It becomes the reference point for everything after
description: For the rest of the life, 'bad' is measured against that fortnight. Ordinary problems get scored as nothing, which sounds like resilience and is actually a calibration fault - real problems stop registering until they are large.
energy_note: Nothing else ever seems serious enough to deal with.
